[5] (ran1_resolution_chunks, sim=0.5208)
For the Rel-18 TRS-based TDCP reporting, there is no consensus on the following: Reverting a previous agreement by specifying the TDCP entry value [EQUATION] as “invalid” and a UE behavior to report this entry value when TDCP determination accuracy is low. Clarifying that UE is not expected to be configured with Y, Dn and/or KTRS value(s), wherein at least two TRS instances separated by Dn symbols/slots are unavailable. Adding, in TS 38.214 section 5.2.1.2, the following UE behaviour: when [EQUATION], the UE does not expect the CSI-RS Resources of more than one of the [EQUATION] CSI-RS Resource Sets are configured as QCL source with respect to ‘typeA’ or ‘typeD’ of any potential PDCCH or PDSCH.
